title: semele androgyna var. gayae
intro: Semele androgyna var. gayae, commonly known as the Dwarf Semele or Dwarf Semele Gayae, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is a small, perennial herb native to South Africa, traditionally used in medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Semele androgyna var. gayae include its potential to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isoflavonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
